info.name: Audiobookshelf Minus
info.summary: Serve your audiobooks to Audiobookshelf apps and sync listening progress
info.description:
Turn a folder of audiobooks in your Nextcloud into a small **Audiobookshelf-compatible server**.
- **Listen offline on your phone** with the official Audiobookshelf app (or another compatible player): browse your books, download them once, and listen without a connection. - **Progress syncs** between your devices when they are back online. It is stored in Nextcloud. - **Audiobook ↔ ebook sync** with [CrossPoint Sync](https://github.com/crosspoint-reader/crosspoint-sync): your listening position follows the matching ebook on your e-reader, and back. - **Library page.** See your books by author, series and progress, and upload new ones: title, author, series and cover are filled in from the files, and the right folders are created. - **Series.** Read from tags and folder names, or set on the library page. The app then offers the next book of a series you have started. - **Playlists, collections, tags and bookmarks**, editable details, and a year in review. - **Ebooks** next to your audiobooks or on their own. Works with the OPDS+ app: matching ebooks are added by themselves. - **Podcasts from rePod.** Your rePod subscriptions show up in the apps, and where you are in an episode syncs with rePod and AntennaPod. - **Streaming is optional.** It is off by default, because it costs bandwidth for every listen and some hosting providers limit or forbid it. - **Covers.** Find square covers for books without one, by hand or automatically. This is off by default, because it sends the book's title and author to Apple's public audiobook search. Your files are not changed. - **No extra server.** Everything runs inside Nextcloud in PHP, so it works on managed hosting too.
**How it works**
- Point it at one or more folders, one folder per book (e.g. `Author/Title` or `Author/Series/1 - Title`). m4b, mp3, m4a, ogg, opus and flac are supported. Chapters and covers are read from the files, and a `cover.jpg` in the folder is used when present. - In the app, add your Nextcloud's server address (shown in Settings → Audiobookshelf) and log in with your Nextcloud account. With two-factor authentication, use an app password. - For CrossPoint Sync, create an API key in the same settings page.
**Limits**
- Books are downloaded or played as whole files (with resume). There is no transcoding or HLS streaming. - There is no live (websocket) connection, so the app shows the server as "not connected" (yellow). Downloads, playback and progress sync work normally. - Podcasts, collections, playlists and server-side metadata matching are not supported.
This app is not affiliated with the Audiobookshelf project.
